name: Shadow Shinobi Assassin
description: Crouched shinobi assassin in dynamic stalking stance on a rooftop ridge, dual kunai silhouettes framed by a giant crimson lunar disc.
prompt: A minimalist 2D graphic illustration for a premium video game, inspired by bold cinematic silhouette poster art. A stealth shinobi assassin crouched dynamically on a Japanese tile roof ridge, dual kunai daggers poised in silence, shown primarily as a near-black silhouette with sharp crimson-red accent highlights on mask and blade edges. A huge solid circular crimson sun behind the assassin, simple flat shapes, clean hard edges, pitch black background, dramatic negative space, sharp vector game art style, no anime, no 3D rendering, no soft painting, no gradients, no text, no typography.
